text.en:
Rates of Import Duty. The articles specifically listed in the
Annex hereof. as classified under Section 104 of the Tariff and Customs Code of
1978, as amended, shall be subject to the Most-Favoured Nation (MFN) rate of
import duty in accordance with the schedule indicated opposite each article.

Levy on articles. Upon the effectivity of this Executive
Order, the articles specifically listed in the aforesaid Annex which are entered
and withdrawn from warehouses in the Philippines for consumption shall be
levied the MN rates of import duty therein prescribed.

Repeal. All issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or parts
thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed.
amended or modified accordingly.
@flice of the President ofthe Philipines

Separability. If any provision of this Executive Order is
declared invalid or unconstitutional, the other provisions unaffected shall remain
valid and subsisting.
Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect thirty
(30) days following its complete publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 7th day of October in r in the year of Our
Lord, Two Thousand and Eleven.
By the President:
PAQUITO N. SCHOA, JR.
Executive Secretary
